lines.en: I wind up going over to Kirin's place after she tells me that her parents aren't around.
lines.zh: Kirin 说她父母不在家，于是我最后去了她那儿。

lines.en: I think it's a little odd that she keeps calling me over here in the middle of the day rather than wanting to actually go anywhere, but I guess that's just the kind of person she is.
lines.zh: 她总是大白天把我叫到这儿，而不是想去什么地方，我觉得有点奇怪，不过她大概就是这样的人。

lines.en: I don't have a problem with it. Being here just means it'll be harder for anyone to actually see us together.
lines.zh: 我不介意。待在这儿只意味着别人更难看到我们在一起。

lines.en: It's not like I'd be able to fall back on the 'she's just my student' excuse with her either. If anyone from class saw us, I'm sure they'd have several questions.
lines.zh: 对她，我也没法用「她只是我的学生」那套借口搪塞。要是班上有人看见我们，肯定有一堆问题要问。

lines.en: But either way, I enjoy the time I get to spend with her...Even if I can't ever quite understand what she's feeling.
lines.zh: 但不管怎样，我很享受和她在一起的时间……哪怕我始终不太能搞懂她在想什么。

lines.en: I notice that my phone is about to die as it starts to get dark and decide to head back home for a little while to charge it.
lines.zh: 天色渐暗，我发现手机快没电了，决定先回家充一会儿。

lines.en: Kirin asks if she can tag along but, not knowing if Ami will be there or not, I decide against it.
lines.zh: Kirin 问能不能跟我一起去，但我不确定 Ami 在不在家，就没答应。

lines.en: She gets surprisingly frustrated when I tell her this and proceeds to be dismissive for the entirety of our very-brief goodbye.
lines.zh: 听我这么说，她意外地有点恼，整个简短的道别过程都一副爱搭不理的样子。

lines.en: But even with that in mind, I feel like the two of us have grown somewhat closer...
lines.zh: 但就算这样，我也觉得我们俩多少近了一些……
